input.query: WITH w AS (SELECT date_trunc('week',decision_date)::DATE week,sum(n_approved)::DOUBLE/sum(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' GROUP BY 1) SELECT avg(rate) baseline_weekly_mean,stddev_samp(rate) baseline_weekly_sd,min(rate) baseline_weekly_min,max(rate) baseline_weekly_max FROM w WHERE week >= DATE '2026-01-05' AND week < DATE '2026-04-13'
SELECT release_date,version FROM stg_app_releases WHERE platform='ios' AND release_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-05-01' ORDER BY release_date
